$comment: Canonical framework patch set. pnpm only honors patchedDependencies at the app/workspace root, so these ship inside @octane-xplat/cli and downstream apps materialize them via `xplat patches apply` (copies files into <app>/patches/ + merges the yaml block). `pnpm sync:patches` generates the config package's patch files and the template config; `pnpm check:patches` fails on drift. Maintain a patch with `pnpm patch <specifier>` + `pnpm patch-commit` — the root workspace yaml points here so commit writes land in this dir. Entries with `template: false` target repo-internal environments (e.g. the windows preview matrix) and are omitted from the starter's patchedDependencies — pnpm fails install on declared-but-unused patches.

patches.why: Published octane 0.6.3 lacks live signal reads under universal renderers. Adds signal ownership, read tracking, and local signal hooks; JSX prop lowering and __methodDep already ship upstream. Routes uncaught universal event-handler errors to onUncaughtError when configured. Pins instance signal/query declarations to their declaring owner so child reads and event handlers share one request. Makes universal useImperativeHandle honor optional refs, ref replacement, nested ref arrays, and callback cleanup. Also allows async and generator helpers that are not components in universal compiler modules, while preserving errors when those functions are used as components (octanejs/octane#1469). Adds renderer-owned Children.toArray/map for transparent deferred JSX groups, plan ranges/slots and arrays, preserving keyed wrapper identity while leaving scoped owners intact.
patches.dropWhen: An octane release ships universal signal reads and the workspace upgrades to that release and forwards uncaught event-handler errors to the root callback and preserves instance declaration ownership across child readers and universal useImperativeHandle has the DOM ref lifecycle and the compiler allows async/generator non-component helpers while continuing to reject async/generator components (octanejs/octane#1350) and universal renderers export key-preserving child collection normalization

patches.why: Published 9.1.3 ships the #11446 nested-tab-frame lifecycle fix and iOS explicit-size flex alignment, so those hunks are removed. Retains the unshipped parent-padding measure-spec fix and Android explicit-size flex alignment, iOS continuous corner clipping, CSS @layer cascade support, custom Android variable-font weight mapping, and percentage translate parsing, native view, and animation support. Verified against the registry 9.1.3 tarball; it has no Windows implementation, so the separate Windows preview patch remains.
patches.dropWhen: A published @nativescript/core release contains the remaining flexbox measure/alignment, continuous corners, cascade layers, custom Android variable-font weight mapping, and percentage-translate fixes (NativeScript/NativeScript#11481).

patches.why: @nativescript/vite serializes bundled CSS and dev app.css through reworkcss `css`@3.0.0, which mis-parses @layer into garbage selectors — rules die before reaching _populateRules. Adds atlayer() covering block and statement forms. Applies to a transitive dep — no app declares it directly.
patches.dropWhen: npm `css` is unmaintained — drop when @nativescript/vite's serializer stops using it (e.g. pointed at NS's vendored css/lib/parse; NativeScript#11462)

patches.why: Dev-server fixes still missing after @nativescript/vite 8.0.17 added percent decoding for path-style /ns/m and Vue /ns/sfc requests (NativeScript#11483): collect re-export specifiers in the .vite/deps rewrite, route /@fs paths outside both roots through /ns/m (linked checkouts bypass the device transform upstream), and probe the non-active platform + `native` suffix tags in module candidates. The deps-bundle esbuild passes ignore vite resolve.alias, so a dep importing bare `octane` bundles the DOM runtime beside the universal one (hooks crash on boot, octane-xplat#3) — an onResolve plugin redirects `octane` → `octane/universal/native`. tsconfig-paths and the generated build-time checker moduleSuffixes also need the `.mobile` tier for iOS/Android/visionOS so `.mobile` leaves resolve under mapped imports and `ns build`. Served `/node_modules/` tails now also scan pnpm's `.pnpm` store and `link:`/`file:`/`portal:` dep roots — a linked package's transitive deps (e.g. @iconify/utils under @octane-xplat/icons) resolve nowhere else and 404 the dev session. findMonorepoWorkspaceRoot no longer treats a lone turbo.json as a workspace root — Turborepo's per-package task configs marked apps/* as roots, masking the real pnpm root so served `/node_modules/` tails never reached the `.pnpm` store scan and non-hoisted transitive deps like source-map-js 404'd dev boot.
patches.dropWhen: @nativescript/vite handles re-export records in the .vite/deps rewrite, routes outside-roots /@fs paths through /ns/m, probes non-active platform and `native` suffixes, honors resolve.alias in deps-bundle esbuild passes, adds the .mobile tier to both tsconfig-paths and generated checker moduleSuffixes (the checker tier is tracked as NativeScript#11480), and resolves node_modules module URLs against the pnpm store and link:/file:/portal: dep roots, and stops treating per-package turbo.json files as monorepo roots

patches.why: Driver setProp skips `undefined` writes — NativeScript native setters coerce it (e.g. editable → ios.userInteractionEnabled = NO), leaving dead UI that still has its JS listeners. Aligns intrinsic ref types with Octane callback cleanup and nested arrays with optional entries. Advertises the implemented visibility capability so committed suspense bodies can be retained while pending.
patches.dropWhen: @nativescript-community/octane ships the undefined-skip, visibility capability, and Octane-compatible intrinsic ref types

patches.why: octaneServerStrategy's SCRIPT_FILE_RE only covers [jt]sx? — .tsrx edits never emit the deferred ns:hmr-delta broadcast, so component HMR silently never reaches the device. Also counts open /ns-hmr sockets so the update summary stops reporting recipients=0 for delivered updates.
patches.dropWhen: vite-octane release adds .tsrx to the strategy's file matching

patches.why: apps/windows pins the @7d0adce pkg.pr.new preview based on @nativescript/vite 8.0.13, so its separate patch carries /ns/m re-export records, vendor-manifest gating for plugin-patterned packages, percent-decoding (the preview predates 8.0.17/#11483), and .mobile-aware tsconfig-paths probing.
patches.dropWhen: windows moves off the preview pin — the real fix lands upstream with the windows platform merge (NativeScript#11272/#11468)

patches.why: Windows spike: the shared-file subset of the 9.1.2 patch — @layer cascade machinery (css-tree parser, css-selector, style-scope), the #11446 frame/tab-view common fixes, and the flexbox common measure-spec — applied to the @7d0adce preview. iOS/Android impl-file hunks are dead code on windows and were dropped. Repairs Windows replacement-only pointer event registration with independently owned subscribers, ref-counted hover, unload/reload cleanup, cancellation/capture-loss handling, disabled guards, and separated tap/double/long-press delivery. Repairs parent-driven percentage sizing initialization, resize/reparent/load/unload ownership, and padded content-box updates. Restores Windows input focus/blur events and lifecycle ownership, IsEnabled forwarding, explicit accessible names, fail-closed secure readonly, and literal non-CSS property values.
patches.dropWhen: upstream ships the fixes and windows moves off the preview pin (NativeScript#11462, #11446, core windows merge); pointer observer source fix is retained in .agents/patches/windows-pointer-core.patch until an upstream release contains it. Percentage sizing source fix is retained in .agents/patches/windows-layout/core-percent-source.patch until upstream includes it. Input source repair is retained in .agents/patches/windows-input-core.patch until upstream includes it.

patches.why: Enables `resolveHiddenExtensions` on the language plugin's typescript facet so extensionless specifiers (e.g. './Text') probe `.tsrx` after moduleSuffixes — required for a single extensionless shared barrel to resolve per-platform leaves under tsrx-tsc and the IDE plugin.
patches.dropWhen: @tsrx/typescript-plugin sets resolveHiddenExtensions in its typescript facet upstream

patches.why: linkifyjs declares /\p{L}/u and /\p{Emoji}/u as regex literals at module scope; NativeScript's embedded V8 builds without ICU, so the literals throw SyntaxError at parse time and poison the whole bundle (any bundled app importing @tiptap/extension-link dies on boot). Rewrites them as try/catch new RegExp builds with ASCII-range fallbacks — same behavior where ICU exists, graceful degradation where it doesn't.
patches.dropWhen: linkifyjs ships an ICU-free-compatible build, or the leaf stops pulling @tiptap/extension-link

patches.why: useEditor.ts reads bare process.env.NODE_ENV — no node global exists in the harness typecheck program. Adds a module-local process declaration for typecheck. (The './Context' self-import half of the 0.0.51 patch shipped upstream in 0.0.52 via octanejs/octane#1502.)
patches.dropWhen: @octanejs/tiptap declares process ambiently in useEditor.ts (closed unmerged upstream) or the leaf stops typechecking its raw sources

patches.why: @lexical/link declares a /\p{L}\p{N}/u URL matcher as a regex literal at module scope; NativeScript's embedded V8 builds without ICU, so the literal throws SyntaxError at parse time and poisons the whole bundle (any bundled app importing @lexical/link dies on boot). Same fix as linkifyjs: try/catch new RegExp with an ASCII-range fallback — the matcher only feeds autolink, which native doesn't use.
patches.dropWhen: upstream builds the URL matcher via new RegExp, or NS runtimes ship ICU

patches.why: ui-image 5.x regressed two iOS prefetch behaviors the 4.x line shipped (still present in 4.6.20): prefetchToCacheType ignores its cacheType argument — SDWebImagePrefetcher's default context stores to disk+memory either way, so a 'disk' prefetch also decodes and warms memory, diverging from Android's bytes-only Glide downloadOnly — and getContextFromOptions drops PrefetchOptions.headers because it never sets SDWebImageContextDownloadRequestModifier, so prefetch({headers}) silently sends no headers on iOS while Android's CustomGlideUrl forwards them. Ports upstream's own 4.x implementation — SDWebImageContextStoreCacheType on the prefetch context plus the request-modifier branch in getContextFromOptions — and additionally sets SDWebImageContextOriginalStoreCacheType so a memory prefetch does not spill original bytes to disk.
patches.dropWhen: a ui-image 5.x release restores the 4.x storeCacheType + prefetch-headers behavior on iOS and the workspace upgrades to it
